Toronto launches back-to-school safety campaign

Toronto police have initiated a 'back-to-school' safety campaign. Mayor Olivia Chow has reiterated her call for the installation of speed cameras. Separately, a student in Bruce County missed the first day of school due to safety concerns. In Thames Valley, a new elementary school opened on the first day of classes. Coverage also included information on healthy school lunch ideas and general school zone safety.
